args.message:
Use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money per FIN-212

The function was using ROUND_HALF_UP while its contract and
tests/test_money.py expect ROUND_HALF_EVEN.

args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` in `src/money.py` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP` despite its docstring and `tests/test_money.py` expecting banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`) per FIN-212.

## Change
Switch the rounding mode to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`:
- `Decimal("2.675")` → `2.68`
- `Decimal("2.665")` → `2.66` (banker's rounding — this case was failing nightly)

## Testing
CI run `ci-0001` on `fix-bankers-rounding-fin-212` (sha 08d3cd5986) passed, including `tests/test_money.py`.
